data.name: Mind Steed
data.description: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to conjure a spectral horse. This horse can be either Medium or Large, but it otherwise functions as mount

raw_tokens.value: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to conjure a spectral horse. This horse can be either Medium or Large, but it otherwise functions as mount
with a base land speed increased by 20 feet|PREVARGTEQ:InvestigatorLVL,5

If you expend 1 additional point of inspiration, the mount can fly at a speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability, but doing so reduces the mount's duration to %1 minutes.|InvestigatorLVL|PREVARGTEQ:InvestigatorLVL,9
